scope: Harness detour only; no vision work

findings.title: Every session pays for situation-specific procedures
findings.evidence: The workspace root is720lines/50,322bytes. Existing guidance is200lines or12KB; procedures for job materials, hosting, claims and writing are mixed with universal boundaries.
findings.cost: ~12,580tokens by bytes/4 estimate; native token cost varies.
findings.smallest_fix: Keep a compact invariant spine and route procedures to their job; move text with ownership/trigger/consumer proof.

findings.title: Repository rules are not guaranteed to arrive before an out-of-directory write
findings.evidence: Claude settings has no PostToolUse instruction loader and live Codex hooks/list has no read-first/loader. Historical loaders were deliberately disabled; Jev does not supply the omitted instructions.
findings.cost: Agents discover authority after an unsafe route, or carry the50KBroot defensively.
findings.smallest_fix: Certify targeted first-write authority surfacing; correct docs now; preserve the deliberate old-hook retirement.

findings.title: An older installed maintenance command hides its recovery path
findings.evidence: Project Meta old recipe defaults write scope to dot without typed broad-scope metadata; current upstream typed bootstrap handles this intentionally. The root example omits file paths.
findings.cost: Failed sanctioned route and manual investigation; one current bootstrap took~60s silently.
findings.smallest_fix: Repair old consumer diagnostic/example or upgrade through sanctioned installer; name SESSION_WRITE_PATHS and its maintenance alias.

findings.title: Generated wiki files can push a small edit over the trivial limit
findings.evidence: Installed commit rule counts every diff and treats AGENTS/CLAUDE as running things; AES#190/#204 remain open. Current active followup ownership must be respected.
findings.cost: Plan/adoption work for small documentation or instruction maintenance.
findings.smallest_fix: Account for declared generated output and provide an honest quick planning path; retain instruction-change scrutiny.

findings.title: A successful process can be recorded as substantive proof when all tests skipped
findings.evidence: Installed evidence.py maps exit0 to SUPPORTS absent a downgrade; it does not require a substantive executed verification.
findings.cost: False confidence in evidence driving acceptance.
findings.smallest_fix: Use structured runner outcomes; zero substantive executed checks yields INCONCLUSIVE, with both skipped and passed controls.

findings.title: A tiny worktree is charged a fixed2GiB admission request
findings.evidence: storage-policy tool wrapper calls gate(2) for every git worktree add; an earlier gate(0.1) cannot change that request. AES#182 records20.57GiBfree,20GiBreserve.
findings.cost: Sanctioned isolation blocked despite ample space for a small checkout.
findings.smallest_fix: Estimate tracked checkout blobs and preserve the reserve and scratch cap.

findings.title: Generated role files match while important role semantics disappear
findings.evidence: sync_agents.py preserves body/description and inferred sandbox but drops model/skills/tool-list meaning in Codex; its parity check compares the same lossy projection.
findings.cost: False parity assurance and context/tool behavior differing by client.
findings.smallest_fix: Translate supported native fields, expose unsupported semantics and verify actual dispatch/tool/loading behavior.

findings.title: Native discovery alone did not prove the specialist could load
findings.evidence: The initial generated specialist was uninstalled and Claude frontmatter was misplaced. Native installation then exposed Codex O_NOFOLLOW rejection of symlinks. Agent-skills PRs450/451 repaired discovery and managed regular-file loading; installed Claude and Codex consumers now complete the bounded investigation.
findings.cost: Projection tests cannot demonstrate native file discovery or use.
findings.smallest_fix: Completed: native frontmatter, compact shared boundaries and source-owned installation; retain installed-consumer checks for both clients.

findings.title: Skill catalog estimates omit part of the real session catalog
findings.evidence: Shared sync passes but its own policy check fails:45automaticCodexvs32;17,102metadatacharacters. Native local skills/list reports92enabled. Remote injected and cached catalogs differ.
findings.cost: Catalog context and misleading thresholds; no native truncation established.
findings.smallest_fix: Measure actual exposed metadata separately from loaded skill bodies; narrow job catalogs only after consumer evidence.

findings.title: The instruction quality checker can omit mixed instruction filenames
findings.evidence: The checker selects CLAUDE or AGENTS for an entire repository; the audit independent git-index inventory retains both and806instructionfiles.
findings.cost: A clean checker result can miss nested authority.
findings.smallest_fix: Discover both filenames, then classify source authority separately; add a mixed-layout test.

findings.title: A live guard still carries older approval instructions
findings.evidence: Installed Jev policy fromOct2asks deployment/default-push/org-merge approval despite later root grants. Bounded log501decisions all observe;495modelcalls median350.75ms.
findings.cost: Delay and misleading recommendations; this sample does not establish a hard approval block.
findings.smallest_fix: Reconcile the owning policy source with later authority and replay the relevant counterexamples.

findings.title: The reported goal-to-hosting diversion remains unverified
findings.evidence: No exact native evaluator trace was supplied or recovered by this audit yet; the retired local stop hook does not prove behavior of the native evaluator.
findings.cost: The historical cost cannot yet be attributed to a particular hook.
findings.smallest_fix: Inspect the exact goal/evaluator trace before changing stop semantics; state linkability/deployment boundaries in goals.
